gate_spec.aggregation: equal pair weight; no dropped pairs
gate_spec.primary: weak_margin = original weak target ROI mean logit minus original hard-background ROI logit
gate_spec.secondary_required: own weak_logit delta median > epsilon; versus full_F median >= -2*epsilon
gate_spec.position_cost_threshold: one original image pixel plus2*epsilon_position; null remains unavailable
gate_spec.full_not_helping: update weak_margin delta median <= epsilon and positive pair count <= negative pair count (noise ties excluded from signs)
gate_spec.removal_benefit: own margin and weak_logit delta medians > respective epsilon in both roles; margin advantage versus full_F median>2*epsilon and positive pairs >=10 update/>=9 observer; weak_logit advantage median>=-2*epsilon
gate_spec.removal_cost: one fixed cost metric has update deterioration median above its pairwise threshold,with >=8 update pairs jointly showing margin advantage and this cost; observer cost median above measurement epsilon (position:one pixel+epsilon)
gate_spec.multi_source_support: joint update pattern must include at least2 distinct predeclared source IDs; batch aggregates are not source-specific effects
gate_spec.config_benefit: same benefit rule as removal,using config versus full_F
gate_spec.config_avoidance: for a supported removal/cost path,config cost median versus full_F <= pairwise threshold and config improvement versus removal median > pairwise threshold in both roles; >=9/16 pairs in each role jointly show margin advantage and do not reproduce that cost
gate_spec.config_new_cost_veto: any cost metric showing median deterioration above pairwise threshold and >=9/16 harmful pairs in either role blocks256-step launch
gate_spec.execution: all required real parameter updates must be finite and strictly nonzero; declared config fallback is counted by reason/source and retained among all16 pairs,not an extra blocking gate
gate_spec.missing: weak metrics require all16 pairs in each role; a missing cost measurement cannot support or clear that cost path and is not replaced by0
gate_spec.interpretation: Descriptive pre-registered directional gate,not a significance test or proof of detected-target loss.ROI scores/peak shifts are proxies;negative gradient cosine alone never triggers.
